text:
Iris Park: FYI support reported customers confused about cost for mixed-dim batches. can Console show a per-request estimate before send?
Noah Kim: yes, but cheap UX needs a client-side estimator. also consider an optional hint header so Console and SDKs align quickly
Iris Park: thinking optional header called `X-Embed-Client-Estimate` and a small JS helper in our SDKs. header format: `units=8;ver=1;nonzero=120`
Diego Alvarez: propose we keep header advisory only. server will always compute final units and return `X-Embed-Server-Units` if different
Priya Rao: how to compute units client-side? simple deterministic formula: units = nonzero_dims * per_dim + ceil(byte_count/1024) * per_kb + sparse_fraction*0.2. provide model baseline in SDK config
Noah Kim: model baseline matters. SDK should accept model_id or fetch model profile from /v1/models to compute per_dim. avoid surprises if user uses newer model with different per_dim
Iris Park: Console UX: show preview "Estimated units: client / server" and grey out send button until server responds? maybe just show a small tooltip explaining differences
console-bot: UX hint: show an inline "Estimate mismatch" indicator when server units > client estimate by 20% with a link to "how estimates are calculated"
Diego Alvarez: telemetry: capture client_estimate, server_estimate, delta_pct, sdk_version, route. don't log raw vectors — only counts and hashes
Priya Rao: edge cases: compressed payloads (gzip), mostly-zero sparse vectors, and mixed dense+sparse batches. add optional hint headers `X-Embed-Nonzero` and `X-Embed-Sparse-Frac` so clients can be precise without sending actual vectors
Noah Kim: server behavior: if server splits request, include `X-Embed-Server-Units: units=21;split=3` and `X-Embed-Split-Plan` as an opaque id for follow-up. Console can surface a "Try split preview" button that runs a simulated split for the user
Iris Park: rollout: opt-in header for SDKs for 48h, Console preview for 2% orgs, collect telemetry for a week. if stable, roll to 25% then GA. we'll add docs and sample SDK snippets
Diego Alvarez: I'll draft the header spec and unit tests to assert SDK vs server parity on common cases
Priya Rao: note on alerts: create an alert when median delta by sdk_version > 30% over 30m. tag engineering owners for quick follow-up
Iris Park: excellent — I'll open the PR with spec + Console mockups and tag everyone for review :thumbsup:
